message:
feat(apk, sh-strength r3): 선명화 방식 기본 / 화면 크기 (실험) -- B as a user's choice; its layout coherent, no redraw without a change

Codex codex_sh_strength_r2.md: B ships as a user option, A stays the default; N1, N2.
- SharpenMethod (stored on its own key, unset = DEFAULT/A) picked in settings ("선명화 방식": 기본 / 화면 크기 (실험),
  with "글씨를 더 또렷하게 표시 · 기기에 따라 지연·발열 증가"). A change replaces a live renderer through the policy's
  new restartRenderer (released and confirmed before the next starts). Off is direct whatever the method.
- N1: the output is sized for the view as soon as B is INTENDED (a filtered level, no fallback), so a renderer starts
  with the layout it draws; the placement carries the view size it was made in and is drawn as fractions of it; video
  goes only into an output of that size -- a buffer not there yet is moved on by up to two cleared swaps (not latched,
  not counted), the frame waits.
- N2: a placement equal to the one in use is not sent (UI) nor redrawn (renderer); a burst is one task taking the
  newest. A new renderer starts with none sent.
The test seam's switch (shTestDisplayPass/Double) stays test-only and overrides the setting in test builds.

Product / test / docs: product (APK settings, persistence, policy, renderer, viewer wiring) / test (none in this commit) / docs (none).
